front: Push and pull factors in rural-urban migration?
back: Push: low farm incomes, drought, land shortage. Pull: jobs, schools, services in towns.

front: Why does a high dependency ratio hold back development?
back: Income goes to supporting dependants, leaving less for saving and investment.
The gain when the working-age share rises and the dependency ratio falls, if there are jobs and skills.
Loss of skills and labour (brain drain), partly offset by remittances.
